description: Tickets are Jira issues (via the Atlassian MCP connector or the REST API).

fetch.instructions: Use the Atlassian connector (getJiraIssue) or GET /rest/api/3/issue/{ticket}?expand=renderedFields. Save summary, description, acceptance criteria, issue type, priority, linked issues and every comment verbatim to ticket.md. Never store the API token.

reply.post: manual or connector, only on the user's explicit go
